summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-ext-mwv preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun standalone runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a bundled 727KB obfuscated file (math_init.js) shipped in the package. math_init.js carries the obfuscator.io signature (rotated string-array via a shift function, `_0xNNNN` hex-mangled identifiers, single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` header) and is not the advertised React-components code — dist/ contains only a 6-line ExampleComponent stub and an ionicons re-export. Executing under a freshly downloaded Bun binary rather than the ambient Node runtime evades Node-only install-time sandboxes and scanners. The package presents itself under the @servicetitan scope as "React components for mobile webviews," but the substantive install-time behavior is the runtime drop and obfuscated payload execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
